01.reason: The Exilarch banquet incident is one segment that opens with Rava's ruling it depends on; it cannot be cut and the next segment is new discussion.

02.reason: Rafram bar Pappa's synagogue incident and Rava's rebuke form the complete story; what follows is a new mishna.

03.reason: The meal where Mar Zutra threw fruit ends with his reply; the next segment is the Gemara reconciling the baraitot.

04.reason: The two students' story is complete in its single segment; the next segment is a separate site story.

05.reason: Rabba bar bar Hana's golden dove story is complete; the following segment is the Gemara's homiletic explanation of the dove.

06.reason: The man saved from the lion and Rava's instruction form a complete story; Mar son of Ravina's miracles that follow are a different incident.

07.reason: Mar son of Ravina's willow-spring miracle in segment 4 is part of the same story, since his blessing in segment 5 names both the willows and the camel.

08.reason: The matron's exchange with Rabbi Yehuda son of Rabbi El'ai is complete; the next segment is an unrelated teaching of Rav Yehuda.

09.reason: Rabbi Bena'a's account of the twenty-four dream interpreters is complete; the next segment is the Gemara's discussion of the maxim.

10.reason: TWO STORIES: the Roman emperor with Rabbi Yehoshua and King Shapur with Shmuel are parallel anecdotes in one segment that cannot be separated.

11.reason: Bar Haddaya's story runs from his introduction to his death in segment 23; the next segment is a different dream story.

12.reason: The heretic's dreams interpreted by Rabbi Yishmael end with the coins found; what follows is general dream symbolism.

13.reason: The dreams of Rav Pappa, Rav Huna and Rav Ashi and their appointments are complete in one segment; what follows is dream lore.

14.reason: Rabbi Sheila's trial and the killing of the informer end in segment 7; his homily on the verse that follows is exposition.

15.reason: Rav Sheshet's greeting of the king runs to the heretic's fate in segment 7; the next segment is a separate site story.

16.reason: Ulla and Rav Hisda at the ruined house end with Ulla's consolation; the next segment is a baraita on blessings.

17.reason: The meeting with Rav Hanina son of Rav Ika ends with his death; what follows is halakhic discussion of blessings.

18.reason: Rav Ketina's reply calling the necromancer a liar in segment 6 finishes the encounter; the later explanations of earthquakes are discussion.

19.reason: Rabbi Hanina's healing of Rabbi Yohanan is complete; the next segments are the Gemara's question and answer about it.

20.reason: Rabbi Yohanan's visit to Rabbi Elazar runs from the dark room to the healing; the next segment is a separate site story.
